title: Law to screen detained youth for early release
summary: This bill would require the Administration for Children's Services to set up borough-based teams that review the cases of youth held in secure detention for at least 7 days and recommend candidates for early release or case resolution. The teams, which would include ACS, Probation, Department of Education and other agency staff, must meet twice a month and share findings with each youth's defense attorney. ACS would also have to publish a public report twice a year on how many youth were reviewed, recommended for release and actually released.
